summary.en: Installer and manager for the Animal Crossing: New Horizons in-game agent.
summary.zh: 《集合啦!动物森友会》游戏内增强 Mod(agent)的安装与管理工具。

details.en:
Installs the in-game agent for Animal Crossing: New Horizons into the game's own directory, and removes it again in one tap.

It detects the installed game build and supports ACNH 3.0.3 only -- anything else is refused. Every file is checked with SHA-256 before it is written, and a failed install leaves nothing behind.

After installing, restart the game and use chat codes: type `/9C9` at the start of a chat line (the slash marks it as a code, the rest is the item's id) and the item goes straight into your bag.
details.zh:
把 agent(游戏内增强 Mod)装进《集合啦!动物森友会》的游戏目录,也可以一键删除还原。

自动识别当前游戏构建,只支持 3.0.3,不认识的一律拒绝;写入前逐文件校验 SHA-256,失败不留半成品。

装好后重启游戏即可使用聊天码:在聊天栏行首输入 `/9C9`(`/` 是标记,后面是物品编号),物品就会直接放进背包。

changelog.en: 1.0.0 - first public build: environment detection, verified install/uninstall with one-tap rollback, offline install from the bundled agent, signed update check with one-tap update, Chinese/English interface.
changelog.zh: 1.0.0 - 首个公开版本:环境识别、逐文件校验的安装/卸载与一键回滚、内置 agent 离线安装、带签名的更新检查与一键更新、中英双语界面。
